entities.summary: Mark Barberio is a Canadian professional ice hockey defenceman who currently plays for HC Bolzano of the ICE Hockey League (ICEHL). Barberio was selected by the Tampa Bay Lightning in the sixth round, 152nd overall, of the 2008 NHL Entry Draft.
